role: Declares the WindowSelector class (Sendable; immutable config plus a lock-protected lastOrganizedZones side channel) and its RecoveryWindow / WindowSelectionResult result types with classification labels and organization thresholds.
types: WindowSelector: class (final, Sendable) — recovery window selector
WindowSelector.RecoveryWindow: struct (Codable) — selected window persisted on analysis results
WindowSelector.RecoveryWindow.WindowClassification: enum (String, Codable) — Organized Recovery / Flexible / High Variability / Insufficient
WindowSelector.WindowSelectionResult: struct — the analysis window (best organized window, else the band's peak-RMSSD window marked not organized; nil only when neither exists) + peak capacity
state: static RecoveryWindow.maxOrganizedLfHf = 1.5 (dormant: lfHfRatio always nil in production)
toplevel: RecoveryWindow and WindowClassification get synthesized Codable (persisted inside HRVAnalysisResult; raw values are the stored classification strings decoded by MorningResultsView+Reanalysis:402).

units.does: Localized compact label for a classification: Organized / Flexible / Variable / N/A.
Lock-protected getter/setter for the organized zones found by the last findBestWindow call.
